svg.title: SLL v1: the 16-byte pseudo-header
svg.desc: The 16-byte SLL v1 pseudo-header of frame 1 of sll.pcap, 32 bits per row: packet type 0 (unicast to us), hardware type 1 (Ethernet), address length 6, the source address 44:15:24:20:a5:64 padded to 8 bytes, and protocol 0x0800; the LinuxSllLink struct on the right holds the same values and the 52 bytes after the header are the IPv4 packet.
